typicalChallenges: Where is the threat model and does it cover all identified attack vectors?
How are security controls tested and validated on an ongoing basis?
What is the vulnerability management process and what are the patching SLAs?
How will you detect and respond to a security incident in this architecture?
What is the operational overhead of the security controls (agent management, log collection, scanning)?
How will security patching be coordinated with service availability requirements?
What security tooling needs to be operated and who is responsible for it?
How do security controls impact application performance and user experience?
How are security requirements integrated into the development workflow without slowing delivery?
What security testing is automated in the CI/CD pipeline?
How will security findings be triaged and prioritised against feature delivery?
What security training or awareness is needed for the development team?
What is the cost of security tooling (SIEM, vulnerability scanning, WAF, DDoS protection)?
What are the staffing costs for security operations and incident response?
How do security requirements impact the overall project budget and timeline?
What is the cost of a security breach versus the cost of prevention controls?
